table:columns.name: OGC_FID
table:columns.description: Running row identifier that the conversion added. It is not an attribute of the Geographic Names Register and it is not a stable identifier for the name. Use placeNameId for that.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: The service's own feature identifier, formed as the letters PNS, an underscore, and the place name identifier. Note that the identifier differs from the placenames Collection's own prefix even where the underlying name is the same.

table:columns.name: placeNameId
table:columns.description: Permanent unique identifier of the place name, an eight-digit integer beginning with 4. It is the same identifier the placenames Collection uses for the same name.

table:columns.name: placeNameVersionId
table:columns.description: Version number of the place name record. It pairs with placeNameId to identify one state of that name.

table:columns.name: spelling
table:columns.description: The written form of the name. Finnish and Swedish spellings are checked by the Institute for the Languages of Finland and Sami spellings by the University of Oulu.

table:columns.name: language
table:columns.description: Language of the name as a three-letter ISO 639-3 code. The five values are fin Finnish, swe Swedish, sme Northern Sami, smn Inari Sami and sms Skolt Sami.

table:columns.name: languageOfficiality
table:columns.description: Standing of the name's language under the Finnish Language Act in the municipality the place's location point falls in. The values are 1 an official language of that municipality and 2 an unofficial language of it. This describes the language in that municipality, not the name itself.

table:columns.name: languageDominance
table:columns.description: Standing of the name's language under the Finnish Language Act as the majority or minority language of the municipality the place's location point falls in. The values are 1 the majority language and 2 the minority language.

table:columns.name: placeNameSource
table:columns.description: Source of the place name information. The published code list currently holds a single value, 1 the National Land Survey of Finland, so this column is constant in practice.

table:columns.name: placeNameStatus
table:columns.description: Status of the name from the standpoint of name curation. The five values are 1 official, 3 checked after 2013, 5 as shown on the Basic Map, 7 another name taken into the Place Name Register, and 9 under checking. Only odd numbers are used.

table:columns.name: placeNameCreationTime
table:columns.description: Time at which the name was recorded in the register. The column is a timezone-aware timestamp in UTC. It does not state when the name came into use.

table:columns.name: placeNameModificationTime
table:columns.description: Time at which the name record was last changed in the register. The column is a timezone-aware timestamp in UTC.

table:columns.name: placeNameDeletionTime
table:columns.description: Time at which the name record was deleted from the register, empty for a name still in force. Every row sampled during authoring was empty, so the column may carry a text type rather than a timestamp type until a deleted name is harvested.

table:columns.name: placeId
table:columns.description: Permanent unique identifier of the place this name belongs to, an eight-digit integer beginning with 1. Several rows share one placeId when a place has several names.

table:columns.name: placeVersionId
table:columns.description: Version number of the place record this name belongs to.

table:columns.name: placeType
table:columns.description: The place's most precise classification, the fourth level of the place classification hierarchy. There are 153 seven-digit codes, published as Paikannimirekisterin paikkaluokitus and through the publisher's code list service as placetype.

table:columns.name: placeTypeDescription
table:columns.description: The same seven-digit code as placeType, resolved against a separate code list that supplies the full prose definition of the place type instead of its short label.

table:columns.name: placeTypeCategory
table:columns.description: First level of the place classification hierarchy, a single digit. The nine values are 1 terrain, 2 waters, 3 populated places, 4 administration and public services, 5 protected sites, 6 transport, 7 production, industry and commerce, 8 culture, sports and recreation, and 9 other cultural objects.

table:columns.name: placeTypeGroup
table:columns.description: Second level of the place classification hierarchy, three digits, 30 values. The code always begins with its own placeTypeCategory digit, so the hierarchy is strictly prefix-based.

table:columns.name: placeTypeSubgroup
table:columns.description: Third level of the place classification hierarchy, five digits, 59 values. The code always begins with its own placeTypeGroup, and placeType in turn always begins with its subgroup.

table:columns.name: placeElevation
table:columns.description: Height of the place's location point above sea level in metres, computed by interpolation from an elevation model. It is not a surveyed height.

table:columns.name: tm35MapSheet
table:columns.description: The TM35 map sheet the place's location point falls in. The identifier is prefix-decomposable, the full seven characters naming a sheet at 1 to 5,000, six characters a 6 by 6 kilometre sheet at 1 to 10,000, five a 12 by 24 kilometre sheet at 1 to 25,000, four a 24 by 48 kilometre sheet at 1 to 50,000, three a 48 by 96 kilometre sheet at 1 to 100,000 and two a 96 by 192 kilometre sheet at 1 to 200,000. The letter increases from south to north and the digit from west to east.

table:columns.name: gslsMapSheet
table:columns.description: The general map sheet division sheet, Finnish yleislehtijako, that the place's location point falls in. It is based on KKJ, the Finnish system used for printed maps before 2007, and its leading digit is the KKJ zone. Seven characters name a 5 by 5 kilometre sheet at 1 to 10,000, six a 10 by 10 kilometre sheet at 1 to 20,000, four a 30 by 40 kilometre sheet at 1 to 100,000, three a 60 by 80 kilometre sheet at 1 to 200,000 and two a 120 by 160 kilometre sheet at 1 to 400,000. There is deliberately no five-character level. The publisher nowhere expands the abbreviation GSLS.

table:columns.name: rescueGridSquare
table:columns.description: The rescue services grid square, Finnish pelastuspalveluruutu, that the place's location point falls in. Six characters name a 10 by 10 kilometre square, five a 20 by 20 kilometre square, four a 40 by 40 kilometre square and three an 80 by 80 kilometre square. There is no two-character level. The publisher supplies the decomposition but no defining authority document for the grid itself.

table:columns.name: municipality
table:columns.description: The municipality the place's location point falls in, as a three-digit zero-padded code. The classification is maintained by Statistics Finland and the code itself is issued by the Digital and Population Data Services Agency. Finland had 308 municipalities in 2026.

table:columns.name: subregion
table:columns.description: The sub-region the place's location point falls in, as a three-digit zero-padded code, 69 values. Statistics Finland states that sub-regional units ceased to be an official regional division at the beginning of 2015 and are maintained only for the time being. This is not a NUTS level.

table:columns.name: region
table:columns.description: The region the place's location point falls in, as a two-digit zero-padded code, 19 values from 01 to 21 with 03 unused. This is the NUTS 3 level for Finland.

table:columns.name: scaleRelevance
table:columns.description: A ranking of the place's size and importance, expressed as the scale denominator of the smallest-scale national map product on which the place's name is shown. A higher number means a more prominent place. The ten values are 0, meaning the name is not shown on the publisher's maps at all, then 25000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, 1000000, 2000000, 4500000 and 8000000.

table:columns.name: placeCreationTime
table:columns.description: Time at which the place was recorded in the register. The column is a timezone-aware timestamp in UTC.

table:columns.name: placeModificationTime
table:columns.description: Time at which the place record was last changed in the register. The column is a timezone-aware timestamp in UTC.

table:columns.name: placeDeletionTime
table:columns.description: Time at which the place record was deleted from the register, empty for a place still in force. Every row sampled during authoring was empty, so the column may carry a text type rather than a timestamp type until a deleted place is harvested.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: The place's location point in WGS84 coordinates, the same point for every name of that place. The publisher's schema names this element placeLocation and defines it as a point near the feature's centre, and for a river the coordinates of its mouth. This Collection carries it as the feature's geometry rather than as an attribute, which is why no placeLocation column appears here.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct(xmin double, ymin double, xmax double, ymax double)
table:columns.description: Bounding rectangle of the row's geometry in WGS84 coordinates. This is the GeoParquet bbox covering column, which speeds up spatial filtering. Because every geometry is a point, each box is degenerate and its minimum and maximum ordinates are equal.

style.description: Default visualization for PlaceNameSimple, drawn in #2a6275.

style-categorical.title: PlaceNameSimple categorical style
style-categorical.description: Categorical visualization coloring PlaceNameSimple by language, one distinct color per value.

style-labeled.title: PlaceNameSimple labeled style
style-labeled.description: Default visualization for PlaceNameSimple with placeNameId shown as text labels.

style-graduated.description: Graduated visualization coloring PlaceNameSimple by placeType, ramped from 1010105.0 to 9999999.0.
